scripts.l10n: echo Generating app_localizations_xx.dart from app_xx.arb; cd app && flutter gen-l10n
scripts.server-dev-new: rm -fr server/data/einz.sqlite.db* && rm -fr server/data/files && npm run server-dev
scripts.server-docker: cd deployment; git pull; docker compose up -d --build server; docker compose down; docker compose up -d; docker compose logs -f server
scripts.server-docker-new: rm -fr deployment/data/einz.sqlite.db* && rm -fr deployment/data/files && npm run server-prod
scripts.app-apk-emu-run-local: bash scripts/patchPubCache.sh && cd app; flutter run -d emulator-5554 --dart-define-from-file=localConfig.android.json
scripts.app-apk-emu-run-local-new: bash scripts/patchPubCache.sh && cd app; flutter install -d emulator-5554; flutter run -d emulator-5554 --dart-define-from-file=localConfig.android.json
scripts.app-apk-emu-run-remote: bash scripts/patchPubCache.sh && cd app; flutter run -d emulator-5554

scripts.app-apk-build-prod: bash scripts/patchPubCache.sh && cd app; flutter build apk --release && mkdir -p _release.gitomit && mv build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-release.apk "_release.gitomit/einz.$(date +%y%m%d%H).apk" && ls -lh "_release.gitomit/einz.$(date +%y%m%d%H).apk"
scripts.app-ios-emu-boot: xcrun simctl boot "${EMU_UDID:-720C22F9-D844-44EE-BDA6-87900913A39B}"; open "$(xcode-select -p)/Applications/Simulator.app"; xcrun simctl list devices booted
scripts.app-ios-emu-run-local: cd app; flutter run -d "${EMU_UDID:-$(xcrun simctl list devices booted | grep -oE '[0-9A-Fa-f-]{36}' | head -1)}" --dart-define-from-file=localConfig.ios.json --pid-file /tmp/einz_flutter.pid
scripts.app-ios-emu-run-local-new: xcrun simctl uninstall booted cc.tic.einz.ios; cd app; flutter run -d "${EMU_UDID:-$(xcrun simctl list devices booted | grep -oE '[0-9A-Fa-f-]{36}' | head -1)}" --dart-define-from-file=localConfig.ios.json --pid-file /tmp/einz_flutter.pid
scripts.app-ios-emu-run-remote: cd app; flutter run -d "${EMU_UDID:-$(xcrun simctl list devices booted | grep -oE '[0-9A-Fa-f-]{36}' | head -1)}" --pid-file /tmp/einz_flutter.pid
scripts.app-ios-emu-run-remote-new: xcrun simctl uninstall booted cc.tic.einz.ios; cd app; flutter run -d "${EMU_UDID:-$(xcrun simctl list devices booted | grep -oE '[0-9A-Fa-f-]{36}' | head -1)}" --pid-file /tmp/einz_flutter.pid
scripts.app-ios-emu-refresh: echo '热重载（只刷新界面，不重置状态）'; kill -USR1 $(cat /tmp/einz_flutter.pid)
scripts.app-ios-emu-reload: echo '热重启（重启逻辑，重新走启动流程——适合本次改动，能看到进入对话页的最新效果）'; kill -USR2 $(cat /tmp/einz_flutter.pid)
scripts.app-ios-deps: cd app && flutter pub get && cd ios && pod install
scripts.app-ios-build-adhoc: bash app/ios/buildIos.sh adhoc && cd app && mkdir -p _release.gitomit && mv build/ios/ipa/einz.ipa "_release.gitomit/einz.adhoc.$(date +%y%m%d%H).ipa" && ls -lh "_release.gitomit/einz.adhoc.$(date +%y%m%d%H).ipa"
scripts.app-ios-build-appstore: bash app/ios/buildIos.sh appstore && cd app && mkdir -p _release.gitomit && mv build/ios/ipa/einz.ipa "_release.gitomit/einz.appstore.$(date +%y%m%d%H).ipa" && ls -lh "_release.gitomit/einz.appstore.$(date +%y%m%d%H).ipa"
scripts.app-ios-install-adhoc-ip11-steps: ls ~/Library/MobileDevice/Provisioning\ Profiles/; cd app; flutter build ipa --release --export-options-plist=ios/exportOptionsAdhoc.plist; ls -la build/ios/ipa/einz.ipa; xcrun devicectl list devices; rm -rf /tmp/einz-ipa && mkdir -p /tmp/einz-ipa; unzip -q build/ios/ipa/einz.ipa -d /tmp/einz-ipa; xcrun devicectl device install app --device 00008030-0005306011F9402E /tmp/einz-ipa/Payload/Runner.app
scripts.app-ios-install-adhoc-ip6s: bash app/ios/buildIos.sh adhoc && ideviceinstaller -u 01418b9159ab75651272f3e5616c3e3fc5dd7d1e install app/build/ios/ipa/einz.ipa
